Brand Concierge FAQ (no Workfront mention), Workfront Fusion apps and modules index (no Brand Concierge connector), Experience League search for Workfront and Brand Concierge.

Workfront Fusion apps and modules index (no Customer Journey Analytics connector), Experience League searches for Workfront with Customer Journey Analytics connections; only a community forum question turned up.

notes: Workfront Fusion is the link in marketo-workfront, workfront-ajo and XB13. Adobe's Fusion pages list a Workfront Fusion license as a requirement, separate from the Workfront license.

The Use Case Patterns page also lists 'B2B Journeys using Marketo Data', which needs Journey Optimizer B2B Edition and Real-Time CDP B2B Edition. It is not used for marketo-ajo or marketo-rtcdp, which rest on standard-edition pages (the Journey Optimizer Marketo Engage custom action, the Marketo source connector and the Marketo Engage destination).

Marketo source connector: without Real-Time CDP B2B Edition only the people and activities datasets reach Real-Time Customer Profile; all Marketo datasets for segmentation need B2B Edition. The Marketo destination does not support account or prospect audiences.

Journey Optimizer Marketo Engage custom action: the page says the action supports ingestion of persons and custom objects but does not say whether it creates or updates records, and does not mention triggering Marketo campaigns.

marketo-target: the Send a List page names Adobe Target as a destination, and also says a list 'can also be accessed by Adobe Target' after it reaches Audience Manager, so the path may need Audience Manager or Experience Cloud audiences in between. Target access must be turned on in Target. Not available for HIPAA-ready Marketo instances. Confirm with the client's setup before quoting.

marketo-eds and XB13: the Edge Delivery form actions (Submit to Marketo Engage, Invoke Workfront Fusion) carry the AEM Forms badge and list an AEM Forms as a Cloud Service instance as the prerequisite. AEM Forms is not on the canvas, so these lines are optional (default false) and have no 'needs' id. aem.live's Forms page also lists 'Submit to Marketo Engage'.
Marketo's own AEM integration (Asset Selector into Design Studio) supports AEM 6.4 and 6.5 only, so it is not used for marketo-eds.

workfront-eds: Workfront's native integration is with Experience Manager Assets as a Cloud Service (or Assets Essentials), not AEM Sites. Metadata moves only from Workfront to AEM. XB12 assumes the client has AEM Assets with its Edge Delivery site; flag this when quoting. Workfront Fusion also has AEM MCP modules that work across 'sites, digital assets, content fragments', but that page does not mention Edge Delivery.

Coworker industry limit: the Workfront Coworker page says 'CX Enterprise Coworker is not currently available to organizations in health care, finance' and some other sensitive industries. The Coworker for Marketo Engage page does not mention this limit. This matters for the FSI play.

Coworker home page lists Coworker Chat in Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, CJA, Target, AEM, Workfront and Marketo Engage, and says the B2B editions of Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer and CJA are coming soon. A separate 'Coworker for teams' offering has a Marketo Engage connector that pulls smart and static lists; it was not used for marketo-cw because it may be a different offering from CX Enterprise Coworker.

The Workfront Fusion index also lists 'Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker modules' and 'Adobe Target modules'. The Coworker modules page failed to load, so it is not cited. Workfront and Target were not in scope.

Brand Concierge to Marketo: the integration page is a video overview and points to a separate 'Brand Concierge data in Marketo Engage' document that was not found. The Brand Concierge FAQ says meeting scheduling uses Adobe Marketo Qualifier, a separate product.
Workfront 'what': the business.adobe.com FAQ text was truncated after 'plan, track, and manage'; the closing words 'their work' are ours.
WF06 and MK06 monthly scope is inferred from Adobe's ongoing feedback cadence (Workfront) and audit areas (Marketo); Adobe publishes no monthly service list.
